text:
zoe: FYI the weekly KPI view just flagged an anomalous conversion bump on the webinar traffic at 07:04 UTC. Traffic +210% vs baseline. Anyone touching sends/partners?
ben: I see it. Which funnel? Launch > Webinar > Regs?
maya: Yep that one. Pulling GA now. Also checking the attribution window  30d or session-based?
frank: Quick heads up  Ops ran a partner promo at 07:00 but it was meant to be internal. Could be the culprit. ops-bot?
dash-bot: Event: partner-promo-internal-09 sent=2026-04-02T07:00:12Z recipients=3,900 links_tracked=true tags=[promo_internal]
zoe: OK. Two parallel asks: 1) mark the KPI dashboard as "promo-noise" for the 07:00 spike; 2) normalize campaign labels for reporting so the week-over-week trend isn't skewed.
ben: For normalization, we should add a derived field campaign_norm in the ETL mapping cohort aliases -> canonical campaign. I'll sketch a mapping: {"webinar_q2_trial" , "webinar_q2"}.
maya: Please don't overwrite raw utm_campaign in SFDC. Add campaign_norm at ingestion time.
frank: Agreed. Also need to confirm lead-to-SDR routing. If these leads are test/internal, they should map to QA queue not SDR.
dash-bot: SFDC extract snippet:
```
lead_id,created_at,utm_campaign,utm_source,assigned_queue
L-10451,2026-04-02T07:01:03Z,webinar_q2_trial,partner-x,SDR-EU
L-10452,2026-04-02T07:02:17Z,webinar_q2,organic,SDR-NA
L-10453,2026-04-02T07:03:45Z,webinar_q2_trial,partner-x,QA-Temp
```
ben: Looks like routing is mixed; QA-Temp is already catching some but not all. We'll need a short sync with ops to retro-tag any leads incorrectly routed.
zoe: For the KPI readout at 09:15 please include: raw signups (as-is), campaign_norm signups, and a note about routing adjustments. Also show 7-day median baseline and percent delta.
maya: I'll add a small panel: visits vs baseline (7-day median), signups raw, signups_norm, conversion rate normalized. Add a footnote: "internal partner promo triggered at 07:00; numbers annotated"
frank: Ops will run a backfill to populate campaign_norm for 06:50-07:30 window and move any internal-test leads to QA-Temp where appropriate. ETA 90 mins.
ben: Also recommend adding an automated dashboard flag when internal send events are detected (cross-check webhook sends with campaign hits). Saves future manual scrubs.
dash-bot: Action created: add_dashboard_flag_on_partner_internal_sends. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.internal/marketing-sends (auth required).
zoe: Good. One more ask: include MQL rate before/after normalization so execs can see whether quality changed. If quality drops significantly, we call it out in the summary.
maya: Will compute MQL rate for normalized cohort and baseline last 7 days and show side-by-side.
frank: Pausing the partner internal list for now and versioning the link templates.
ben: Adding a short line in slide notes: "Annotation applied; normalized series used for trendline. Raw series retained in appendices"
zoe: Thanks team. Quick 15-min huddle at 09:00 to finalize. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
